packet-08 -- unverified image reading (UTF-8 plain text)

EXPOSURE NOTE: No proposed identification of the work or author was in my context. The images themselves carry modern pencil shelfmark labels ("Stams, STA, Frg. 115_1r" ... "_6r"), and my session's background notes mention Stams fragments in passing for an unrelated project; neither names a text. Nothing beyond the brief's rules was done except reading image dimensions with sips to work out which tile belongs to which fragment.

LAYOUT SURVEY (image-001, overview of face 1 = "r" sides)
Observation: six separate parchment fragments on black ground, with a colour checker and a ruler. Upright orientation. Each carries a modern pencil label:
- 115_5r (top left): horizontal strip, 3 lines of text across its top edge; rest of strip blank. Looks like a cut strip (lower margin or a binding strip).
- 115_6r (middle left): small piece, 3 lines at top, holes; rest blank.
- 115_4r (top centre): tall narrow piece, single column, ~29 lines, left edge trimmed through text? (text runs to right edge, cut on right side; line beginnings visible on left). Damaged top edge.
- 115_3r (top right): near-square piece, ~27 lines, single column, text cut at right edge; a small red stroke near left middle (rubric/paraph trace?). Marginal note at left about line 6 ("q(uo)ta ..."?).
- 115_1r (bottom left): ~30 lines single column, damaged top-left corner. A bracket mark at right edge mid-page.
- 115_2r (bottom right): ~31 lines single column, damaged top-left; a small marginal note at left near top.
All in one small, cursive Gothic book hand (textualis/cursiva mix), heavily abbreviated, brown ink; no ruling clearly visible at overview size. No running titles, no enlarged initials seen at overview size. Lines on 3r, 4r, 1r, 2r seem cut at one or both side edges, so lines are likely incomplete.
Tentative interpretation: fragments of one Latin prose manuscript (sermon/treatise-like prose with frequent "d(omi)n(u)s", "x(rist)us"-type abbreviations), cut up for binding.
Tile mapping assumed from tile shapes: 002=5r, 003=6r, 004/005=4r top/bottom, 006/007=3r top/bottom, 008/009=1r top/bottom, 010/011=2r top/bottom. Face 2 (overview image-012, tiles 013-022) presumably the "v" sides.
